message.content:
**Fastest Route (by car)**  
*Distance:* ~215 mi (≈3 h 30 min)  
*Route:* **I‑95 N** (the most direct and quickest way)

| Leg | Directions | Approx. Time |
|-----|------------|--------------|
| 1 | From NYC, take the **New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N)** out of the city. | 0 min |
| 2 | Continue on I‑95 N through NJ, PA, and MD. | 1 h 45 min |
| 3 | In Delaware, stay on I‑95 N until you reach the **Delaware River Bridge** into Delaware. | 10 min |
| 4 | Cross the Delaware River into Delaware, then keep on I‑95 N. | 5 min |
| 5 | Enter Pennsylvania again, then continue on I‑95 N. | 15 min |
| 6 | Pass through the Baltimore area; stay on I‑95 N. | 20 min |
| 7 | Enter Maryland, then keep on I‑95 N. | 10 min |
| 8 | Cross into Massachusetts; I‑95 becomes **Massachusetts Turnpike (I‑90 E)** briefly. | 5 min |
| 9 | Merge onto **I‑93 N** toward Boston. | 10 min |
| 10 | Follow I‑93 N into Boston. | 5 min |

**Total:** ~3 h 30 min

---

### Quick Tips

- **Traffic:** Peak times (weekday mornings/evenings) can add 30–60 min. Check real‑time traffic apps (Google Maps, Waze) before you leave.
- **Tolls:** I‑95 N has several toll plazas (NJ Turnpike, Delaware River Bridge). Have an E‑ZPass or cash ready.
- **Alternate Routes:**  
  - *I‑84 W* (via Hartford) – longer (~250 mi) but can avoid some congestion.  
  - *US‑1* (coastal) – scenic but slower (~260 mi).

Enjoy your trip! 🚗💨
